finalText:
**1082 hits in 94 files.** About 900 are safe internal code in `services`.

Four places must keep `account_id`:

| Where | Hits | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public field. Renaming breaks every client. |
| `lib/serialize.js` line 8 right side | 1 | Sends the public name. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 12 | Generated. Refresh overwrites edits. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 37 | Already ran in production. |

Also, 125 SQL strings in `repo` files name the real database column. Those only change after a new migration renames it.
